about: Sounds YAMNet hears that get their own engraving. classes are YAMNet (AudioSet) indices from yamnet_class_map.csv; an event fires when any of them scores at least threshold in a 3 s window. For talking and children only the fact is kept: no audio is stored and no words are recognised. minHits: how many 3 s windows within a minute must hear it before it counts (default 1), for sounds that a single noisy window fakes easily. enabled: false switches a sound off by default (it can be switched back on in the app's settings). notNearPlane: not counted while a low plane is within 3 km (near an airport a jet's rumble fakes it). weather: "thunder" counts only when Open-Meteo has a thunderstorm around (WMO 95-99) in the last 3 hours or the next one.
